id: title:jose-sequeira:bump the rds ca bundle checksum pin

review.posthog_relevance: Updates the TLS certificate authority bundle hash used by PostHog's containerized runtime to establish secure connections to AWS RDS databases, maintaining compatibility with updated AWS RDS TLS implementations.
review.reason: The provided chunk contains two hunks, P1.F1.H1 and P2.F1.H1, both modifying the Docker build argument `RDS_CA_BUNDLE_SHA256`. This argument specifies the SHA256 hash of the AWS RDS global CA bundle used during the Docker image build. The change updates this hash from one value to another, indicating a replacement of the underlying CA bundle dependency. This is a maintenance change
review.uncertainty: The exact reason for the hash change is not documented in the provided observations; it could be routine maintenance, a dependency update, or a response to a security advisory. No systemic improvement or new capability is demonstrated. The benefit is limited to compatibility and security posture maintenance rather than a substantive feature or reliability improvement.

observations.limitations: The provided chunk contains only one hunk. No other hunks are supplied, so no multi-hunk relationship or broader change group can be established. No score is assigned.
